Hello,

I saw your opening for a Jr. Graphic Designer at Nestasia, and I appreciate how your home decor and lifestyle collections focus on artisanal quality and aesthetic appeal.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have designed over 100 digital and print creatives, incorporating AI-assisted workflows in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator to speed up ideation and keep turnaround times low.

You can see my visual identity work in my branding kit for the AT Creation startup, which demonstrates my approach to typography, layout, and brand systems: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I am based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Hyderabad, and would welcome a quick look at my portfolio when you have a moment.

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
